meta.title: RAIN to SUNSHINE in Minutes ☔➡️☀️ | Da Nang Weather Update January 2026
meta.description:
Today I’m walking along My A Beach in Da Nang, Vietnam, and this video perfectly shows how unpredictable the January weather can be. The walk starts with rainy season clouds and light rain, then suddenly turns into bright sunshine and blue skies—a very typical day in Da Nang during January.

If you’re planning a trip and wondering:

Is Da Nang worth visiting in January?

How bad is the rainy season really?

What does My An Beach look like right now?

This real-time walking tour gives you the honest weather update, beach conditions, and current vibe in Da Nang. You’ll see locals and tourists, sea conditions, and how fast the weather can change on the coast.
This video is useful for:
✔️ Travelers planning Vietnam in winter
✔️ Digital nomads in Da Nang
✔️ Anyone curious about Da Nang rainy season reality
✔️ January 2026 beach and weather updates
📍 Location: My An Beach, Da Nang
📅 Filmed: January 2026
🌦️ Weather: Rain turning into sunshine
Don’t forget to like, subscribe, and comment if you enjoy real, unfiltered walking tours and daily Da Nang updates.

comments.author: @ThanhSơnPham-d2r
comments.text: Have you ever visited Quy Nhon? It's also a great seaside city, quite similar to Da Nang but with fewer tourists, mostly locals. It's still a hidden gem. Some Westerners living there even say to keep this city a secret because they don't want it to become a second Da Nang. Quy Nhon even has better weather than Da Nang because it rarely experiences storms like Da Nang.

comments.text: ​ @louyht7 Vung Tau is also nice, but not as pristine and peaceful as Quy Nhon. It's very crowded with tourists, mostly Vietnamese from Ho Chi Minh City – even more crowded and noisy than Da Nang, especially on weekends. During major holidays, the beaches are incredibly packed!
